IELTS:

- Did you know that varying your sentence structure and word choice can help you achieve a better score?

TOEFL:
As an ETS-trained TOEFL coach and CELTA-certified teacher, I’ve developed proven strategies to help you succeed.

Learn how to effectively skim and scan academic passages, master time management, and confidently tackle university-level reading tasks. 

Let’s work together to build your confidence and get the score you need to achieve your goals in one try!

	•	Enhancing your ability to be clearly understood in both professional and casual conversations.

Whether you’re aiming to improve your communication skills for work, public speaking, or everyday interactions, this course will equip you with the tools you need to achieve a more polished accent. Let’s embark on this journey to clearer and more confident English speech together!

Are you happy with your speaking skills, but still want to improve your writing? Do you have trouble organizing your thoughts in English when it comes to putting pen to paper (or fingers to keyboard)? Maybe you want to start an English journal, or you want to try out different writing styles (emails, letters, opinion pieces, short essays). If so, this is the class for you! In this class, we'll focus on strengthening your writing capabilities. We can work on organization, creative writing, or style- whatever you would like to focus on. Prior to our class, I will carefully examine your writing sample and help you determine your strengths and identify errors. Then, we will work together during the class to enhance your writing and make any necessary corrections. 

*the price includes the corrections I make outside of class and our class time together*

pro_course_detail.description: At level B we are conversing with more fluidity, we are refining our language skills and constantly expanding our vocabulary. pro_course_detail.title: German conversation, language refinement, cultural-linguistic exploration
pro_course_detail.description: Level C language classes might be focussed on a specific topic or project either for work or school. Language acquisition might be necessary for a variety of reasons, but that doesn't mean it can't be fun and entertaining. All levels begin with the student and teacher getting to know each other, discussing what the student's language aims are and what their goals are in general. At Level C we will continue enhancing expression and language flexibility.
